brief:
Ihab Abu Jazar, coach of the Palestine football team, said the role represents both the suffering of his people and their aspirations, Al Jazeera English reported. Despite personal difficulties, Abu Jazar described coaching the national squad as a distinction he wears with pride.

The coach framed his position as carrying symbolic weight beyond the sport itself, with the team serving as an emblem of Palestinian resilience and hope amid ongoing challenges.
dek: Despite navigating personal hardships, Ihab Abu Jazar calls it a 'badge of honour' to coach the Palestine football team.
title: Palestine coach calls team a badge of honour despite hardship
